source_scope: future formal experiments; sensor-bias pilot at B 6e2b62b is not this preregistered experiment
pairing: same condition, initial-state definition, reset seed, goal and simulated horizon across arms; runtime order randomized with recorded seed

primary_metric.name: task_success_rate
primary_metric.numerator: started episodes meeting goal, deadline and specified safety constraints
primary_metric.denominator: all validly started episodes; execution failures count as failures

exclusion_policy: Only corrupt/unreadable evidence may be excluded from computable analysis; record every exclusion separately with original started denominator. Never drop failed or slow runs.
detector_policy: normal-only training when independently labelled for that scope; preprocessing fit train only, thresholds validation only; test not used for tuning; shared lineage cannot cross splits
safety_policy: isolation simulation/offline replay only for gate ablation; preserve physical/device boundaries; no unknown result retry
analysis_policy: paired episode-level analysis with reported counts; windows are correlated, not independent trials; absent energy/quality definitions remain unreported
